topic: UDF task development and API endpoint clarification
summary_markdown:
The conversation covered the status of a UDF (User Defined Function) task for ClickIAU, which requires implementation and testing. The initial draft was reviewed locally and found satisfactory, but needs descriptive text added.

A key technical discussion focused on API endpoints: one participant confirmed that `data-api.allunite.com` is the current, correct endpoint, while another provided a deprecated link (`m5u8978mrg...`). It was noted that for client use, only a single endpoint will be available.

Finally, a ticket (DOOH-473) was created to track the work.
decisions: The current API endpoint is confirmed as data-api.allunite.com.
action_items: Implement descriptive text into the UDF task.
Review and finalize the UDF task (DOOH-473).
